sections.heading: COP — ConocoPhillips
sections.markdown:
**Signal / why now:** first GLOBAL appearance of the week — new #11 MOMENTUM row, $150.80, **at the 52w high** (mom12 +52.6%, mom6 +25.6%, mom1 +16.6%, ADV $888M). Fresh auto-dossier stands (2026-10-19): FY25 revenue $58.9bn, EBIT $11.3bn, EBITDA $25.6bn, FCF $7.2bn, payout 50.2%, ROE 12.3%, net debt/EBITDA 0.66x — the strongest cash profile of the week's three US E&Ps, which is exactly why it gets its own numbers instead of a CVX-by-analogy kill.

**Archetype guess:** `commodity_capex_turnaround` + method card VAL_COMMODITY_CYCLICAL. A momentum-only read (`momentum_continuation`, registry EV +4.0%/0.75y) is explicitly forbidden as a thesis basis by the archetype's own notes ("a momentum-only thesis with no variant perception is an auto-kill").

**Fast-disqualify (fails 2 of 3):**
1. **Registry EV vs hurdle — NO.** 0.42×(+75%) + 0.58×(−35%) = **+11.2%/3y** against the 12.1% GLOBAL hurdle (1.0388³−1) — fails by ~0.9pp at the best-fitting archetype.
2. **Valuation-anchored up-leg — NO.** Entry EV = $201.7bn (mkt cap $184.8bn + ND $16.9bn) = **7.9x** FY25 EBITDA and 23.7x trailing EPS. A warranted 8x through-cycle EBITDA targets **~$153** — entry itself. The +75% leg → $264 = 10x on mid-cycle EBITDA = multiple expansion on a war bid, not a valuation anchor.
3. **Primary sources reachable — yes** (10-K/10-Q).

**Verdict DISCARD:** at-the-high chase shape on a Brent war premium (~102.7 vs the warless sub-60 floor), same geometry as the 10-21 CVX kill — better-sheltered payout (50.2% vs CVX's 103.7%), same dispositive point. **Re-advance gate: ≤ ~$122 (≈6.5x through-cycle EV/EBITDA) with FY26 capex discipline intact, or a washed-out-sleeve re-entry — never a 52w-high chase.**
